tracepoint_id_discovery: self-TID getpid probe with id==39 filter; no tracefs writes
launcher: ./scripts/dev_run.sh with test harness installed at target/debug/procinsh
notes: Sleep-fast and busy matrices have three repeats in fixed order, without CPU pinning; target starts with a 300ms sleep.
Observation starts about 100ms after target launch and covers 5s of its approximately 8s runtime.
sleep/futex/epoll long variants wait 6s and can finish later than 8s; initial sleeps 10.3s.
Observer CPU includes ring copy, decode, matching, and pending text diagnostics; excludes open/maps and final symbol resolution.
Exit events carry RAW metadata only by default; exit-stack-8192 samples registers/stack at exit too.
Light events still carry the tracepoint fixed RAW payload including args/return value; this is not a projected ID/time-only payload.
Functional runs add sample_source/time/age diagnostics; matrix binaries have identical sampling and matching logic.
Dumped stack memory is not retained; frames retain only addresses and resolved symbol names.
